title: audit_watch_snapshot v1
description: The auditd watches the manager asked for (audit_watches of the shared oscompliance.json) and whether they are loaded. The agent loads a missing watch with auditctl and never removes one.

auditd.description: running; stopped (the daemon is not running or the kernel audit is off); absent (auditctl not installed); error.

loaded.description: Wanted paths whose watch is loaded with the oscompliance key.

failed.description: Wanted paths whose watch could not be loaded, with the reason.
